transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well, I guess what brings me in is that my body just feels completely out of my control. Um, at first, I was pacing around my apartment all night, just walking back and forth making all these notes for a supper club. But lately... I'm just so slowed down. My sister is the one who really pointed it out. She says it takes me forever just to get my shoes on now.
Have you been hearing voices that other people can’t hear?
No, I haven't heard anything like that. Just my own thoughts, really.
Have you had times recently when your mood felt unusually high or excited?

Yeah, I did. Um, right after I got fired, I actually felt... weirdly unstoppable. Just really excited about everything. But it was also... well, if anyone questioned my plans or told me to slow down, I would just blow up at them. It felt like they were trying to ruin my life.
Have you ever had strong beliefs that other people said were not true, even when your mood was not especially high or low?

No, not really. Um, I mean, people told me my plans for the supper club were completely unrealistic when I was feeling so fired up. But when I'm just feeling normal, or even now when I'm so slowed down... no. I haven't had any beliefs like that.
Right now, do you feel depressed most of the day?

No, I wouldn't say that. I know I just mentioned feeling slowed down, but it's not really depression. I don't feel sad or anything like that most of the day. I just kind of feel... I don't know, lacking energy, maybe. But no, I don't feel depressed.
Have there been times lately when you couldn’t speak at all, even though you wanted to?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I've always been able to talk when I want to. Sometimes I might not feel like talking much, but I've never physically been unable to speak.
When you feel slowed down, do you ever stay in one position for a long time without moving?

No, I haven't noticed anything like that. Um, I mean, if I'm feeling really drained, I might just sit on the couch for a few hours. But I'm not, like, stuck or frozen in place. I still shift around, grab my phone, that kind of thing. So no, I don't just stay in one exact position without moving.
